# Hono Playground API

> A Cloudflare Workers reference API. Items and profiles use JSON:API 1.1;
> health, greetings, and the read-only GitHub API use plain JSON. Profiles
> belong to the principal verified by Cloudflare Access.

This index covers the application's origin-root paths. Resolve root-relative
links against the application origin you are using, including when reading
this file in the repository. Repository source links are separate references.
This source revision may not yet be deployed; retrieve `/openapi.json` from
your chosen running origin before using its operations. For local access, the
[setup instructions](https://github.com/janisto/hono-playground/blob/main/README.md#setup)
configure Alchemy and `just dev` at http://127.0.0.1:8787; that development loop
uses remote Cloudflare resources. The complete guide explains secretless tests.
Neither this index nor the API catalog grants access to protected operations.

## Contract and usage

- [OpenAPI 3.1 contract](/openapi.json): Exact operation IDs, schemas, media types, statuses, and security.
- [Complete API usage guide](llms-full.txt): Requests, authentication, pagination, profile lifecycle, and recovery after uncertain writes.
- [API catalog](/.well-known/api-catalog): Public RFC 9727 links to the contract, guides, and health.

## Reference implementation

- [Routes and application](https://github.com/janisto/hono-playground/blob/main/src/app.ts): Native Hono handlers and middleware composition.
- [Cloudflare Access verification](https://github.com/janisto/hono-playground/blob/main/src/auth/access.ts): Origin assertion validation and ownership.
- [Profile persistence](https://github.com/janisto/hono-playground/blob/main/src/repositories/profile-repository.ts): Drizzle/D1 writes and conditional updates.
- [Contributor setup](https://github.com/janisto/hono-playground/blob/main/README.md): Toolchain, local tests, and stage selection.
